== Overview ==

'''HealthProtocol''' is a simple protocol used to check the status of the game server.

== Methods ==

{| class="wikitable"
! Method ID !! Name
|-
| 1 || [[#PingDaemon]]
|-
| 2 || [[#PingDatabase]]
|-
| 3 || [[#RunSanityCheck]]
|-
| 4 || [[#FixSanityErrors]]
|}

=== PingDaemon ===

Checks if the game server daemon is reachable.

==== Request ====

This method does not take any parameters.

==== Response ====

{| class="wikitable"
! Type !! Name !! Description
|-
| Boolean || %retval% || Whether or not the daemon is reachable
|}

=== PingDatabase ===

Checks if the game server database is reachable.

==== Request ====

This method does not take any parameters.

==== Response ====

{| class="wikitable"
! Type !! Name !! Description
|-
| Boolean || %retval% || Whether or not the database is reachable
|}

=== RunSanityCheck ===

Checks to see if the game server passes sanity checks.

==== Request ====

This method does not take any parameters.

==== Response ====

{| class="wikitable"
! Type !! Name !! Description
|-
| Boolean || %retval% || Presumed to be whether or not the server passes the sanity checks. It is not known if a <code>true</code> value means "checks passed" or "had errors"
|}

=== FixSanityErrors ===

Tries to fix any sanity check errors if any exist.

==== Request ====

This method does not take any parameters.

==== Response ====

{| class="wikitable"
! Type !! Name !! Description
|-
| Boolean || %retval% || Presumed to be whether or not the fixes were applied successfully
|}
